cards.name: Cashback Credit Card

fee_waiver.text: From year two waived with AED 10,000 retail spend; first year free

rules.name: Online and wallet spend
rules.conditions: 10% on saved-card online payments and Apple Pay/Samsung Wallet; cap AED 300 per month shared by all such spend; utilities, telecom, government, supermarkets, education excluded; the engine cannot tell channel, so in-store spend in these categories is over-credited here (in-store earns 1%)

rules.name: Reduced categories
rules.conditions: 0.5% on utilities, telecom, government, supermarkets/hypermarkets, education; kredit also lists fuel, real estate, QSR, insurance, auto dealers, transit/Salik, charity at 0.5%

rules.name: International retail
rules.conditions: 2% on foreign-currency retail outside UAE (EEA merchants 0.3%); applies when not online-wallet 10% category

lounge.text: Free unlimited access to 10+ regional lounges via Mastercard Travel Pass; 1,300+ global lounges if flight delayed 1h+ (register 24h ahead)

welcome_offer.text: No cashback bonus; annual fee free for first year

community_notes.text: Tabby repayments reportedly post under MCC 5999 and earn 0.5% rather than 10%, even via Apple Pay; past 10% results do not guarantee future ones

cards.notes: Official terms: 10% online/wallet capped AED 300 per calendar month; no minimum spend; cashback expires after 36 months, redeem min AED 100, cannot pay card bill with it; utility bills paid via bank's own online/mobile banking earn nothing. Supermarket MCC 5411, utility/telecom 4900/4813/4814, government 9399/9402, education 8299/8220/8211 are low-rate. MCC 5999 reportedly earns only 0.5% (see community). Annual fee AED 199 per aggregator (official page does not state amount); waived by AED 10,000 retail spend in the year; first year free. FX admin fee 2.5%. Profit 3.49%/month on official page. No welcome bonus on official page. Audit 2026-11-27 (official FAQ re-read): the 10% rate, AED 300 monthly cap (on 'accelerated categories', not listed), AED 10,000 waiver spend and 2.5% non-AED fee are official. The annual fee amount, the base rate on other spend and the 0.5% reduced tier are NOT on the official page (it defers to a key fact statement we could not read); they come from comparison sites. The official page never mentions Tabby or credit card bill payments.

cards.name: Smiles Titanium

rules.name: Reduced categories
rules.conditions: education, government, utilities, supermarkets earn 0.5 Smiles per AED 2

cards.notes: Earn 1 Smile per AED 2 domestic (0.5/AED), 2 per AED 2 international. SIB states no AED value per Smile; point_value_aed 0.01 is our placeholder, treat value as unknown. Smiles expire after 36 months. Free for life per T&C. Min salary, welcome, profit rate not found. Not on kredit.ae; may be closed to new applicants (SIB page dated 2020).

welcome_offer.text: 50,000 Smiles for AED 20,000 spend within 90 days

cards.notes: Earn 1.5 Smiles per AED 2 domestic (0.75/AED), 3 per AED 2 international. Welcome 50,000 Smiles for AED 20,000 in 90 days. Fee AED 525 is an inference from an ambiguous T&C table. Point value unknown (placeholder 0.01). May be closed to new applicants.
